rows.note: Official sources connect real-world combat datasets, developer onboarding, operational feedback, follow-on orders, and market scaling.
rows.ceil: public wartime inference and market authority
rows.next: Acquire named validation decisions, unit requests, procurement orders, model versions, and operational outcomes.
rows.fals: The reported data and feedback did not materially affect access, procurement, or scaling.

rows.note: Official statements name security compliance, validation, and operational feedback without publishing the complete threshold set.
rows.next: Acquire access criteria, validation protocols, performance metrics, combat-point rules, review panels, changes, and rejected applicants.
rows.fals: No material threshold governed access, validation, or procurement.

rows.note: The source set describes state, developer, and military-user roles but contains no direct affected-population voice or consequence file.
rows.ceil: developer burden visible, affected-person burden absent
rows.next: Acquire developer appeals, failed validations, unit complaints, incident reviews, affected-person records, and remedies.
rows.fals: No consequential deployment or represented population exists in the bounded system.

rows.note: The feedback-to-follow-on-order mechanism is explicit, while negative feedback and preventive stopping authority are not.
rows.ceil: rapid feedback-to-procurement timing with unresolved stop authority
rows.next: Acquire suspension, recall, no-buy, abort, safety, negative-feedback, and review chronology.
rows.fals: Negative evidence reliably stopped or reversed deployment before material consequence.

rows.note: Official sources identify the platform and participants but not the complete custody and disclosure architecture.
rows.next: Acquire contracts, data licenses, provenance, annotations, access logs, model cards, validation, retention, security, and audit rights.
rows.fals: A public authority independently holds a complete, versioned, auditable, and exportable record.

rows.note: The public system supports multiple developers and suppliers and explicitly uses competition and standards diffusion.
rows.next: Freeze approved, rejected, failed, inactive, funded, procured, and deployed denominators and compare outcomes.
rows.fals: Selection or data access was effectively closed to a narrow private network despite the public count.

rows.note: Wartime urgency makes exception authority consequential; no complete waiver or emergency-deployment ledger is in the estate.
rows.next: Acquire urgent fielding, waiver, security exception, suspension, override, and post-action review records.
rows.fals: No material exceptions existed or all received effective independent review.

rows.note: The public feedback and market cycle is documented; error, injury, compensation, IP, and residual-benefit allocation are not.
rows.ceil: battlefield learning and market metabolism with missing consequence ledger
rows.next: Acquire failures, losses, near misses, compensation, IP, revenue, ownership, standards, and procurement outcomes.
rows.fals: Benefits and risks were proportionately shared and errors were corrected before consequence.
